outcome.technical:
WHAT CHANGED. tests/test_drive_phase.py: (1) `_load` now replaces every loaded driver's `run_verb` with `_in_process_verbs(module)`, which runs each verb's script as `__main__` in the block's interpreter via `_run_in_process` (own argv, cwd, environment, byte-backed stdin/stdout/stderr whose codec and error handler mirror what a child interpreter picks; SystemExit mapped to the exit status; an escaping exception becomes a traceback on stderr and exit 1; sys.stdin/out/err, argv, path, cwd and os.environ restored afterwards) and decodes the bytes with the module's own `_verb_text`/`_record_text`, logging the same `ctx['log']` entry. (2) The suite's own `_verb` (submit, audit-lock status, audit-task, run-test-gate ... called by cases) goes through the same runner. A script that defines `run_verb` (the driver's own `submit`) has it routed in-process too: `_script_parts` splits each script into body and trailing main guard (AST, memo keyed by path+mtime_ns+size) so the patch lands before the command line runs. (3) `_needs_process` keeps a verb a real process when a fixture planted a `sitecustomize` on PYTHONPATH (pinned clock `sc4/sc4b`, Windows stdout) or the case replaced the module's own `subprocess` (the stdin-bytes case). Process-boundary cases untouched and still spawned by hand: ds9/ds9w (command-line exit status), the CRLF brief case (stdout pipe bytes), al-block (children under the ASCII locale). (4) ar-block, the single heaviest block, was cut where no later group reads an earlier binding: new STAGES rows ar5-block, ar9-block, ar18-block placed right after ar-block (replay order unchanged), each loading a fresh driver; sb1 (stage_reach) green. (5) Module docstring and the pinned-clock comment rewritten to say what the suite now does. .github/sweep-costs.json: test_drive_phase.py's 120 block figures and its suite figure re-recorded from the darwin run2 block seconds scaled by 4913.6/2080.0 (the old windows-latest suite figure over the darwin seconds the baseline run measured) -> suite figure 4913.6 -> 2665.5, heaviest block ar-block 596.3 -> ar18-block 196.8; platform note extended to say so.
